# Power Query M function support

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

This reference lists, for every function in Microsoft's Power Query M function list, whether Lumen's M engine implements it. Use it before you paste a query from Power BI Desktop or write one in the Advanced editor.

> [!NOTE]
> This page is generated from Lumen's M standard library (`src/core/m/lib`) and compared with Microsoft's published function list, retrieved from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/ on 2026-11-18. Functions Microsoft adds after that date are not listed. Regenerate with `npx vitest run --config scripts/docs/gen-dax-m-connector.vitest.config.ts gen-m-function-support`.

## Status values

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Implemented | The function works in Lumen. A note says where it differs from Power Query. |
| Recognized, not available | Lumen knows the function, but calling it raises an error that says what to use instead (Windows drivers, Microsoft service sign-in or a browser engine are not available). |
| Not implemented | Calling the function fails. |

Functions that take a culture (for example `Number.FromText`, `Date.ToText`) support `en-US`, `en-GB`, `de-DE` and `fr-FR`; `Culture.Current` is `en-US`. Any other culture raises an error.

## Functions not in Microsoft's list

Lumen also binds these names. Functions marked *Lumen connector* are Lumen's own (`src/core/m/lib/connectors.ts`): Power BI Desktop does not have them, so a query that uses them does not refresh there. The others are Power Query functions that Microsoft's function reference does not list.

| Function | Origin | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `AmazonS3.Contents` | Lumen connector | Implemented |
| `DuckDB.Database` | Lumen connector | Implemented |
| `Fabric.Warehouse` | Power Query | Recognized, not available |
| `Firestore.Collections` | Lumen connector | Implemented |
| `Firestore.Query` | Lumen connector | Implemented |
| `Lakehouse.Contents` | Power Query | Recognized, not available |
| `Lakehouse.Folder` | Lumen connector | Implemented |
| `Lakehouse.Tables` | Power Query | Recognized, not available |
| `Parquet.Document` | Power Query | Implemented |
| `PowerBI.Dataflows` | Power Query | Recognized, not available |
| `PowerPlatform.Dataflows` | Power Query | Recognized, not available |
| `SQLite.Database` | Lumen connector | Implemented |
| `Table.ColumnTypes` | Power Query | Implemented |
| `Type.ForList` | Power Query | Implemented |

Literal constructors such as `#date`, `#datetime`, `#datetimezone`, `#duration`, `#table`, `#time` are also available.

The library also defines 104 constants and enumeration values (for example `Day.Monday`, `JoinKind.LeftOuter`, `Int64.Type`).
